transcript.content: Hello, can I start by asking your name, and what brings you in today? Please tell me in your own words.

My name is... well, I’m here because I just don’t feel like myself. Honestly, it’s like the warm part of me shut off. I’ll sit with my husband, or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or maybe even a little happy, but there’s just nothing there.
How long have you been feeling this way — this lack of feeling or absence of warmth — have these feelings been continuous, or have they come and gone over time?
It’s been about three weeks. It started after the pallet collapsed at work and my coworker got hurt. Since then it’s pretty much been there most of the time, that empty feeling.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with loved ones?

Yes. I mean, I still sit with my husband and I still turn on my shows after work, but it doesn’t feel the same. I know those things should feel comforting, or at least a little nice, but it’s like I can’t get to that feeling. There’s just nothing there.
Have you felt down, sad, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, since this started?

I don’t know if I’d call it sad exactly. I’m not crying all day or anything. It’s more like I feel flat and kind of hopeless about feeling normal again, but I’m not sure it’s “most of the day” every day.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy or felt unusually tired nearly every day since this started?
I haven’t really noticed a big drop like that. I get tired after work, but that’s pretty normal for me. I wouldn’t say I’m unusually exhausted nearly every day.
Would you say you've felt down, sad, or hopeless on most days since this started, even if it's not all day every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had moments where I feel kind of hopeless, but I don’t know that I’d say I feel down or sad most days. It’s more just… off, I guess.
Have you noticed any difficulty thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions since this started?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have moments where I’m distracted, but I haven’t really noticed a big problem with thinking clearly or making decisions.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating much less than usual or losing weight without trying?
No, I haven’t really noticed anything like that. My appetite seems about the same, and I don’t think I’ve lost weight without trying.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual, or found it hard to sit still lately?
Not really. I haven’t noticed myself moving slower, and I don’t think I’ve been especially restless or unable to sit still.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, no longer give you any pleasure or satisfaction?

Yeah… that’s actually a big part of why I came in. I’ll sit with my husband or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel relaxed or happy or something, but I just don’t. It’s like that warm feeling is just gone.
Would you say you’ve had days where you felt a noticeable sense of sadness or depression, not just feeling ‘off’ or empty, since this started?
I’m not really sure I’d call it sadness or depression. It’s more like I feel kind of numb or empty. I have off moments, but I don’t think I’ve had days where I’m just clearly sad like that.
Have you completely stopped enjoying activities that usually bring you pleasure, like time with your husband or your favorite shows, or do you still get some enjoyment, even if it’s less than before?

It feels pretty much stopped, honestly. Like I’ll sit with my husband or put on one of my shows after work, and I know normally I’d feel comfort or a little happiness, but it’s just… nothing. Like that warm part of me shut off.
Just to clarify, have these feelings of numbness and loss of pleasure been present for at least two weeks without a break?
Yes. It’s been about three weeks now, since the pallet collapsed and my coworker got hurt. It hasn’t really let up.
Would you say that you no longer feel any pleasure or satisfaction from activities that you used to enjoy, like time with your husband or your favorite shows, not even a little bit anymore?

Yeah… I’d say not really any pleasure anymore. I’ll sit with my husband or put on one of my usual shows, and I know I should feel comfort or even a little happy, but I just don’t. It feels like that warm part of me is shut off.
Would you say that most days, you feel down, depressed, or have completely lost interest or pleasure in all activities, not just some?

Yes… most days it feels like that. I don’t really get pleasure from anything lately. I’ll sit with my husband or put on a show after work, things that usually make me feel better, and it’s just blank. Like I know I should feel comfort or happiness, but I don’t.
